en.quote: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob. Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah. Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger. Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease. Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
en.riddle: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
en.speaker: Psalmist

bonus_hint.quote: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

he.quote: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמֽוֹר רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שְׁבִית יַעֲקֹֽב נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶֽלָה אָסַפְתָּ כָל־עֶבְרָתֶךָ הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּֽךָ שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּֽעַסְךָ עִמָּֽנוּ
he.riddle: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּֽעַסְךָ עִמָּֽנוּ
he.speaker: מִזְמֽוֹר רָצִיתָ

bonus_hint.quote: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵן יָצָא אָחִיו וְיָדוֹ אֹחֶזֶת בַּעֲקֵב עֵשָׂו וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יַעֲקֹב וְיִצְחָק בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה בְּלֶדֶת אֹתָֽם

en.1: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
en.2: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
en.3: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
en.4: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
en.5: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

he.2: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שְׁבִית יַעֲקֹֽב׃
he.3: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶֽלָה׃
he.5: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּֽעַסְךָ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
